items.title: Introducing OpenAI for Chile
items.summary: Today we’re launching OpenAI for Chile, a partnership with the Government of Chile, led by the Ministry of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation, to support responsible AI adoption in public administration, build civil servants’ skills and help local startups develop useful AI applications.

items.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
